description: This file defines functions and classes for generating and manipulating operation graphs for tensor operations, including filtering operators, creating operation nodes and graphs, and fuzzing specifications for testing purposes within the torchfuzz framework.

classes.name: OperationNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the operation graph, including its ID, operation name, input/output specifications, input nodes, and depth.

classes.name: OperationGraph
classes.description: Represents a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of operations with methods for validation, topological sorting, and dependency analysis.

methods.name: _get_cached_operators
methods.description: Retrieves cached list of operators, initializing cache if necessary.

methods.name: _get_template_filtered_operators
methods.description: Filters available operators based on a specified template and supported operations list.

methods.name: fuzz_spec
methods.description: Generates a random tensor or scalar specification based on a template.

methods.name: fuzz_op
methods.description: Generates an operation and its input specifications to produce a target specification, considering depth and stack constraints.

methods.name: _get_arg_args_specs
methods.description: Creates argument operation specifications with unique IDs.

methods.name: fuzz_operation_graph
methods.description: Constructs a DAG of operations that produce a specified tensor or scalar specification, with optional seed and template.
